# Rathe Day: Lessons of Luclin Lichen

**Level:** 1 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 1
**Maximum Level:** 125
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Task
**Group Size:** Solo

This task is a continuation of the task Rathe Day: Softer than Otmir Fur [quest=12921]. You can get the task from Korah Kai, she is located at +1001,+1948,+32.88 in Hollowshade Moors. She's on Find (Ctrl+F).
You say, 'Hail, Korah Kai'
Korah Kai smiles warmly as you greet her. She's practically bubbling over with excitement to talk with you. 'Well, if it isn't my favorite conservationist! The ursarachnids are sweet, misunderstood creatures and we can learn a lot from them. My fellow nature lovers are in the process of building a sanctuary for them so we can continue to study their behaviors.  Did you know their silk is stronger than steel and can be harvested to make armor?' She takes a moment to calm herself before continuing. 'Since you've made it this far, I'm fairly certain I can't scare you away with anything.' Her eyes grow as large as saucers. 'I want to talk to you about the [lichen] on Luclin, You do not have a choice about this now!'
You say, 'Lichen? As in moss?'
Korah Kai's hands shiver as she fails to contain her joy. 'Close, but no! Moss is considered a plant, while lichen is actually a combination of a fungus and an algae. It creates a symbiotic relationship to create a different creature! Much like the owlbears and ursarachnids, except lichen can survive in some of the harshest climates due to its unique structure, which is called lichenometry. They can detect the slightest changes in their environment and adapt themselves for survival. Because of this, there are thousands of different types of lichen all over Luclin and Norrath. As an amateur lichenologist, I normally spend my free time collecting and studying this stuff, but as of late I have been [too busy].'
You say, 'Too busy? I can help'
Korah Kai says, 'I know you can and that's why I love you. Did you know that some lichen is edible? I would not advise going around and consuming it without the correct knowledge, as it could kill you if you don't know what to look for. Only certain kinds are edible and such lichen can be found here on Luclin. Battle historians have said the Rallosian army would survive long marches by eating whatever they could find. Meat can be scarce and, while many starved to death, some made do with making something that they called "bread moss." I understand that I just told you that it's not a "moss," but this is a bit of a catchall term for the same process. It is an acquired taste and I have a friend who loves the stuff. I just need some from a very specific [location].'
You say, 'What kind of location are we talking?'
Korah Kai proudly exclaims, 'The Paludal Caverns! I need you to head inside and search the caves for any living lichen you will find.' She draws a crude image of what looks like a mass of tangled webs with a mouth. 'Looks something like this. The ones that look like shrubs are called "fruticose." It was there the whole time, but it's more prevalent in the caves during this time of year. Now that you know what to look for, they should be much easier to spot. Since they have absorbed the magical essence that's in the ground in that area, they react poorly to an [untrained] hand.'
You say, 'How can an untrained hand cause them to react differently?'
You have been assigned the task 'Lessons of Luclin Lichen'.
Korah Kai cringes when you ask that question. 'Don't judge me, but it did take me a bit to understand how to collect some Luclin lichen.' She gives a worried smile. 'You gotta pat them on the side that doesn't have a mouth. I discovered it one day when I was bored and gently patted one. A piece fell off and it remained in one piece. Typically the pieces crumble to dust after a few minutes of not being attached. If you pat them, it seems to comfort the main root enough to allow a living sample to break off and survive. Look, I know that sounds crazy, but I don't make the rules. Nature does! Go gather me some lichen from the Paludal Caverns, Kenadi.'
Korah Is happy you have relumed from your work with Reeve Purewing and the ursarachnids. She was afraid of you being too afraid to continue. Having proved her wrong, she has one more task to fully tell you about the Importance of conservation. This time, however, it is no beast you hunt but a type of creature that is a combination of algae and fungus, lichen.
Korah has asked that you head into the Paludal Caverns and retrieve some lichen for her. She warns you that with the peculiar structure of the Paludal Caverns lichen, you will have to pat them in order to collect a piece that won't crumble immediately.
- 1. Collect lichen from the Paludal Caverns 0/1 Paludal Caverns
Look for living Luclin lichen creatures not far from the Shadeweaver's Thicket zoneline near the big pool of water.
Target them and /pat them. You are given Paludal Lichen.
- 2. Deliver the Paludal Caverns lichen to Korah Kai 0/1 Hollowshade Moor
You offered 1 Paludal Lichen to Korah Kai.
You have been given: Paludal Bread Moss Loaf
Your task 'Lessons of Luclin Lichen' has been updated.
Korah Kai  looks pleased with what you brought her, as she gently wraps it in some paper and stuffs it in a shirt pocket. She reaches into a pouch and pulls out a cloth-covered cube. She removes the cloth to show a steaming loaf of bread that has intricate designs cut and baked into the top of it. She wraps it back up and hands it to you. 'When you left, I remembered that I had extra stashed away just for this very reason. I thank you for replenishing my stock. Take this loaf to Tarka in the Cobalt Scar. You will find him at his favorite fishing spot. You may be asking yourself if this tastes any good. I'm happy to tell you that, when prepared correctly, no.'
You complete the trade with Korah Kai.
- 3. Bring the Bread Moss Loaf to Tarka 0/1 Cobalt Scar
Hunter Tarka is in Cobalt Scar at /way -714, -199, 59 along the beach between the druid ring portal and skyshrine.
You offered 1 Paludal Bread Moss Loaf to Hunter Tarka.
You have been given: Tarka's Old Tacklebox
Your task 'Lessons of Luclin Lichen' has been updated.
Hunter Tarka happily takes the loaf of bread from you. He unwraps the cloth from around the loaf and inhales deeply. A waft of the loaf's scent enters your nostrils and assaults your senses. It smells like a hot swamp was baked into a loaf of seaweed. Tarka smiles devilishly and wraps the loaf in the towel before storing it in a pouch on his side. 'Just like how mom made it when I was just a pup. She was a traveling merchant and she would collect lichen from the Paludal Caverns. She would bake a loaf every time she came home. She liked keeping old traditions alive by recreating them without the modern tools. I haven't smelled this smell in a long time. Oh, please bring [this] to Korah.'
You complete the trade with Hunter Tarka.
- 4. Return to Korah and give her the tacklebox 0/1 Hollowshade Moor
You offered 1 Tarka's Old Tacklebox to Korah Kai.
Your task 'Lessons of Luclin Lichen' has been updated.
Korah Kai takes the tacklebox and looks at it confused. She looks at you, then back to the tacklebox. You can almost see the clockwork moving in her head. 'Oh! Tarka, you genius! This is a great idea!' She stops herself quickly and places a hand on her chest as she addresses you, 'Gebb, as always, thank you.' She does an excited little dance before regaining her composure. 'Tarka and I are close and have been for a long time. I consider him a dear friend. I thank you for this, Gebb! Did you know that lichen is also used for making an assortment of dyes? With that being said, you know what I'm going to ask next.' She smiles warmly. 'I need you to gear up and get into Velketor's Labyrinth. The neat thing about the lichen you will find there is that it is very resilient to the cold and is quite sturdy. If you can't collect it from the source, ask around. Someone may have some extra.' She gives you a wink as you go on your way.
You complete the trade with Korah Kai.
- 5. Find lichen grown from within Velketor's Labyrinth 0/1 ALL
You can find the lichen not far from the Great Divide zoneline. Same thing, target them and /pat
You pat a living Velious lichen on the back.
Your task 'Lessons of Luclin Lichen' has been updated.
You are given: Velketor's Lichen
- 6. Give the lichen to Korah Kai 0/1 Hollowshade Moor
You offered 1 Velketor's Lichen to Korah Kai.
You have been given: Velketor's Dye
Your task 'Lessons of Luclin Lichen' has been updated.
Korah Kai sees you approach and she removes a mortar and pestle from her pouch. She kneels down and places the mortar on the ground and removes a few vials from her coat pocket, pops the cork on them and pours them into the mortar. She takes the lichen, placing it in the mortar, and begins to crush it with the pestle. While she is preparing whatever she is preparing, she looks up to speak to you. 'Thank you for this. Yet again I am in your debt and you have made my life a little bit easier.' She's getting winded and stops talking to focus on her work. Once finished, she wipes the sweat from her forehead using the back of her hand before setting down the pestle and pouring the contents of the mortar into an envelope she pulled from her coat. She hands you the [envelope].
You complete the trade with Korah Kai.
- 7. Bring the envelope of dye to Guard Kroffa 0/1 South Kaladim
Guard Kroffa is just inside the zone from ButcherBlock Mountains. Give him the dye.
You offered 1 Velketor's Dye to Guard Kroffa.
You have been given: Bag of Butcherblock Samples
Your task 'Lessons of Luclin Lichen' has been updated.
Guard Kroffa takes the envelope from you and quickly hides it in his armor. 'Ye daft? I din't need tha others ta know I'm out of dye for me drawers!' He reaches for a heavy sack that has a bunch of pockets in it and hands it to you. 'Aye, this be the sack she be wantin'. Filled ta the brim with all o' tha dirt and plants I could find. She kept goin' oon about protecting the land 'n whatever. I din't listen too close. Bring this ta her. Careful, my friend. She'll talk ya ear off about tha stuff if ya let her.'
You complete the trade with Guard Kroffa.
- 8. Deliver the sample to Korah 0/1 Hollowshade Moor
You offered 1 Bag of Butcherblock Samples to Korah Kai.
Your task 'Lessons of Luclin Lichen' has been updated.
Korah Kai excitedly takes the pouch with a flourish and a twirl. 'Thank you, Gebb! As I have promised, I have no more tasks for you. Though what you have done for me today feels like a pile of chores, but I think I'm going to continue doing this every year. Make it an event, you know? Every time the owlbears migrate, we reflect upon our lands and do something to help out Norrath. Maybe call it Rathe Day? Tell you what, I declare to you and all of my lichen samples that, come this time next migration, I will have finished that sanctuary! Thank you for everything yet again, Gebb. I'll see you next year.'
You complete the trade with Korah Kai.
- 9. Speak with the Rathe Initiate 0/1 Plane of Knowledge
a Rathe Initiate can be found at /way -39, -74, -156 not far from the Crescent Reach stone.
You say, 'Hail, a Rathe Initiate'
Your task 'Lessons of Luclin Lichen' has been updated.
Whether you lichened it or not, you did learn the importance of such diverse and incredible creatures. Your actions on this day have shown the Rathe Council can trust you to grasp the importance of conservation. They have deemed this day "Rathe Day" in hopes that creating the tradition of conservation will encourage future generations of explorers to take care of the planet they live on.
You have been given: Living Lump of Luclin Lichen
A Rathe Initiate greets you with a slight bow of respect. 'I welcome your return, adventurer. I thank you for partaking in those tasks for her.' They pause as they scratch what you think is their chin under the mask. 'Rathe Day, huh? We do enjoy the way that sounds. I will return in one year's time to check on Korah's status. It will be interesting to see if you mortals will actually take protecting these lands seriously. Of course it would be easier to do all of this with magicks, but that is just using energy from one ecosystem for another. That is not the lesson we wish to teach here. Doing the work is worth it. We are glad you understand, Gebb. Thank you again. Until next year, my friend.'
You have completed achievement: Rathe Day: Rathe Day Reveler
Reward(s):
Living Lump of Luclin Lichen (Pet Illusion or Familiar)
Submitted by: GidonoRewards:
- Living Lump of Luclin Lichen [item=149037]

# Nights of the Dead: The Lost Handkerchief

**Level:** 1 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 1
**Maximum Level:** 125
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Task
**Group Size:** Solo

Larref can be found at  /way -357, 1099, 24, just down a bit from the tunnel entrance to Kerra Ridge in Toxxulia Forest. She is on the find tool as well CTRL F.
This quest can be picked up along with the others and can be done in any particular order.
You say, 'Hail, Larref'
Larref says, 'Hello! Do you like scary stories? My friends and I are sharing our favorite [scary stories]. '
You say, 'I like scary stories.'
Larref says, 'My favorite story is about the [lost handkerchief]. '
You say, 'The lost handkerchief?'
Larref says, 'Yes! See, a long time ago. There was a fair maiden who was in love with a simple soldier. Her father didn't approve of the match and arranged for the soldier to be sent in to patrol the Warrens. The maiden knew her father was sending the soldier off to die and enchanted a favor for him to wear. That if he carried it, he would [never die].'
You say, 'Never die? That doesn't sound good.'
Larref says, 'They say that he never returned from that patrol and that maybe her father had a hand in his disappearance. The daughter never recovered from her loss. Some say she went mad. Some say that she pushed her father off in the Hole. However, they all agree that she entered the Warrens and never returned. And on the [anniversary] of her death, she can be seen wandering the paths of the Warrens, looking for her love.'
You say, 'When is this anniversary?'
Larref says, 'No one knows for sure, but the sightings have started again. Did you want to go look for the [lady in white]?'
You say, 'Yes, I want to look for the lady in white.'
You have been assigned the task 'The Lost Handkerchief'.
Larref says, 'They say she can be found wandering in the tunnels of the Warrens.'
- 1. Search the Warrens for the ghost 0/1 The Warrens
Location update /way 754, -125, -78.
- 2. Hail Constance's ghost 0/1 The Warrens
Constance's ghost(s) can be found at /way 911, -33, -78.
You say, 'Hail, Constance'
Your task 'The Lost Handkerchief' has been updated.
Constance says, 'Philip... Philip... Where... Where are you?'
- 3. Follow Constance's ghost 0/1 The Warrens
Location update: /way 675, -113, -78.
- 4. Kill the lost trainees 0/1 The Warrens
One at a time, 4 ‘a lost trainee’ attack. Kill them.
- 5. Find and follow Constance's ghost 0/1 The Warrens
Location update /way 339, -48, -74.
- 6. Kill the lost trainees 0/1 The Warrens
Once again, you are attacked by 3 ‘a lost trainee,’ one at a time. Kill them.
- 7. Find and follow Constance's ghost 0/1 The Warrens
Location update /way -33, 365, -88.
- 8. End Philip's suffering 0/1 The Warrens
Philip attacks. Kill him.
- 9. Return Constance's Lost Handkerchief 0/1 The Warrens
Loot Philip's corpse, retrieve the handkerchief and return it to Constance.

Experience - At Level 125 - Less than 0.01% of the experience required to go from level 125 to 126 (or 1.10% of an AA point) and 0.04% of a mercenary AA point.

You say, 'Hail, Laveer Krass'
Laveer Krass says, 'Now that we have some form of respite, let me introduce myself. My name is Laveer Krass. Now let's see [inside] this package here.'
You say, 'What is inside?'
Laveer Krass says, 'Well, this was a bit underwhelming, considering the great lengths you took to get this package to me. There does not seem to be much inside except for an envelope and a [letter]. Give me a moment to read it.'
You say, 'What does the letter say?'
Laveer Krass is visibly distraught. 'This is from my father. He composed music like myself, but I have not seen or heard from him for a long time. Last thing he told me, he was going out to find something, something of great importance. He was in such a rush that I thought it was one of his crazy fits, acting like a mad man. He was an old man in his late years and I did not think anything of it. His previous "revelations" came up unfruitful, but it seems this time was not like the others. He found what he was looking for, but apparently only part of it. He mentions another [group] as well that was seeking what he was looking for. They got to him, but he was able to [send] this to me before they captured him. So most likely the people pursuing both this package and yourself were those same people.'
You say, 'Who was this group?'
Laveer Krass says, 'There does not seem to be any more info on the group that was pursuing you, but it looks like they have some sort of operation going on in the Western Wastes.'
You say, 'What did he send?'
Laveer Krass says, 'The envelope seems sealed magically. I'll need time to unlock it. Would you mind seeing what is [happening] in the Western Wastes?'
You say, 'I'll check on what is happening.'

# 27th Anniversary: #1 - Linguistic Libretto

**Level:** 0 | **Maximum Level:** 130 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 0
**Maximum Level:** 130
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Task
**Group Size:** Solo

This Anniversary task starts with Jharin Kevva in Toxxulia Forest. She is on find (CTRL-F).
You say, 'Hail, Jharin Kevva'
Jharin Kevva gives little attention to Jeffroex. 'Leave me. I have [important things] to attend to.'
You say, 'Important things like an ancient composition?'
Jharin Kevva perks up an ear as he turns from his notations towards Jeffroex, the quill in his hand finding a home in a tiny ink well beside his notebook and an old parchment. He gives the adventurer a slightly longer moment of scrutiny. 'Well, yes. And your curiosity has my attention. You have the look of a person who has [walked the Planes].'
You say, 'Yes, I have walked the Planes.'
Jharin Kevva says, 'A well-traveled person can give wonderful [insight] and perspectives.' He claps his hands together in anticipation. 'What do you think? Do you mind helping me out?'
You say, 'I can share my insight.'
You have been assigned the task 'Linguistic Libretto'.
Jharin Kevva says, 'Spirits with us! Thank you, friend. So...' The Jharin's index finger traces along the table beside the parchment, a mere whisper across the wood and not daring to touch the weathered paper. 'An ancient composition I acquired, but specifically the lyrics and vocal cues. I can only guess the instruments or tune to accompany this ditty. While I can confirm what is jotted down here is a [language], I cannot fathom from where. It may be pre-historic.'
You say, 'Do you have any leads on the roots of the language?'
Jharin Kevva says, 'No, but the text draws me in all the same. I absolutely must translate this.' He furrows his feline brow, and his ears stay alert as he stands deep in thought for a moment. 'Aquatic. A mere guess based on the flowing style of [the lettering], and that the text has avoided bleed over these many years, but I believe it would be a good jumping off point.'
You say, 'Could I study the lettering?'
Missing dialogue
Your task 'Linguistic Libretto' has been updated.
